silent_query_interval_seconds.description: Interval between background silent polling rounds (seconds).

history_limit.description: Max retained latency history points per server.
history_limit.hint: Default 48 (about 24h if poll interval is 30m). Range 1-2048.

status_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for a single MC status request (seconds).
status_timeout_seconds.hint: Default 10. Range 1-60 and covers lookup, DNS, status, and ping.

auto_append_default_port.description: Whether to append default port 25565 when address has no valid port.
auto_append_default_port.hint: Default false. Applies to '/添加服务器' and '/查询服务器 <服务器地址>'.

mutation_requires_admin.description: Require administrator permission for saved-server and template mutations.
mutation_requires_admin.hint: Default true. Applies to command handlers and LLM tools.

direct_query_requires_admin.description: Require administrator permission to query an unsaved address directly.
direct_query_requires_admin.hint: Default true. Queries of saved servers remain available to regular members.

query_all_concurrency.description: Max concurrent requests for '/查询服务器' (all servers).

max_servers_per_session.description: Maximum saved servers in one group or private-session scope.

avatar_download_retries.description: Retry count for each avatar download candidate.

avatar_batch_timeout_seconds.description: Total timeout for collecting one server's player avatars.

render_timeout_seconds.description: Total timeout for rendering one server report image.

query_result_cache_ttl_seconds.description: TTL for single-server rendered image cache.
query_result_cache_ttl_seconds.hint: Default 10. Range 1-300. Repeated single queries within this window return cached image.

skin_api_url_template.description: Skin API URL template used to fetch skin by UUID.
skin_api_url_template.hint: Must be an HTTP(S) URL containing only the '{uuid}' placeholder. Invalid value falls back to default.
